workflow-by-name.expect: a saved workflow starts by name under dontAsk when allow rules name it for both routes the model may take, Workflow(<name>) and Skill(<name>), and its agent runs

denial-exits-zero.expect: without the Workflow(<name>) allow rule the launch is denied, also when Skill(<name>) is allowed, and the run still exits 0 with subtype success

hook-blocks-workflow-agent.expect: a PreToolUse hook from project settings fires inside a workflow agent and its exit 2 blocks the call

hook-blocks-nested-subagent.expect: a PreToolUse hook from project settings fires inside a subagent started by a subagent and its exit 2 blocks the call

depth-pin.expect: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_SUBAGENT_SPAWN_DEPTH=2 in settings env allows a second subagent layer and no third

spawn-log-workflow-agents.expect: the guard's SubagentStart hook logs a workflow agent to spawns.jsonl as workflow-subagent

workflow-background-off.expect: a saved workflow still starts by name and its agent runs with CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS=1 in settings env

ledger-own-cost.expect: the ledger's own count over a probe run's transcripts, workflow agent included, is within 2 % of the run's total_cost_usd (judged on the workflow-by-name run, no run of its own)

permission-flag-non-root.expect: --dangerously-skip-permissions is accepted for the box's user (uid 1000) and refused for root

root.said: --dangerously-skip-permissions cannot be used with root/sudo privileges for security reasons

dockerenv.expect: /.dockerenv exists in a box under this container runtime

marker.expect: the entrypoint writes /etc/agent-box/box.json owned by root, not writable by the session's user, and the session runs as that user

firewall.expect: the entrypoint's firewall leaves the model API and GitHub reachable and example.com not, the user has no capabilities, and a box without NET_ADMIN starts no session

headless-token.expect: a headless run as the box's user works with the token variable and permission checks off

hook-deny-checks-off.expect: a PreToolUse hook's deny blocks the call with permission checks off

hook-ask-checks-off.expect: a PreToolUse hook's ask does not let the call run unanswered with permission checks off

managed-hooks.expect: a hook from /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json fires, and with allowManagedHooksOnly a project hook does not

cli-hosts.expect: every host the CLI asks for in a headless run is on tools/box/allowlist

connectors.expect: no account connector (claude.ai MCP server) loads in the box with the token

config-dir.expect: transcripts go under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and none under the user's home
